background: Swedbank is Sweden's largest retail bank by customers and a leading bank in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, funded by Swedish and Baltic deposits and covered bonds and lending mainly on residential mortgages, with the Baltic money-laundering case behind it.
synthesis: Rated AA on average across all three, the weakest of them at AA-, all on a stable outlook after a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is strong against EU and Nordic banks, CET1 of 17.4% and leverage of 6.2% both above the peer median, and LCR of 162% is above it too, with NSFR of 122% just below. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 2.3 points, leverage 0.4 points and NSFR 7 points, in figures to 30 Sep 2026.
